name: ESPectre Wi-Fi Motion Detection
description: The `espectre` component uses the [ESPectre SDK](https://espectre.dev/sdk/) to detect motion from Wi-Fi channel state information (CSI). Processing runs on the ESP32; no external motion sensor is required.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: ID of the diagnostic sensors group, used by `component.update`.

config_entries.label: Csi Capture Profile
config_entries.description: `auto`, `lltf`, or `ht_vht`. Defaults to `auto`, which selects a profile for the chip, band, and traffic source. `lltf` selects the legacy long training field; `ht_vht` selects HT20 or VHT20 according to the Wi-Fi connection.

config_entries.label: Csi Traffic Multicast Group
config_entries.description: Multicast group joined in `external` mode to receive UDP datagrams, in addition to those sent to the device address. Defaults to `239.255.0.1`. An empty string disables the join. Requires `traffic_generator_mode: external`.

config_entries.label: Detection Algorithm
config_entries.description: `lightweight` or `high_accuracy`. Defaults to `lightweight`. Lightweight detection calibrates its threshold from the environment and uses less detector CPU and memory. High Accuracy detection uses an on-device neural network with trained weights.

config_entries.label: Motion Off Hits
config_entries.description: Consecutive detector evaluations below the threshold required to clear motion. Range 1 to 20. Defaults to `3`. Increase `motion_on_hits` if short bursts trigger motion; reduce it if motion is detected too late.

config_entries.label: Motion On Hits
config_entries.description: Consecutive detector evaluations above the threshold required to report motion. Range 1 to 20. Defaults to `4`, about 1 second at the 250 ms evaluation interval.

config_entries.label: Traffic Generator Mode
config_entries.description: `ping`, `dns`, `dns_tcp`, `wifi_raw`, or `external`. Defaults to `ping`. `ping` sends ICMP echo requests. `dns` sends DNS queries over UDP; `dns_tcp` uses TCP. The experimental `wifi_raw` mode sends Wi-Fi Null Data frames to the access point. It is unavailable on ESP32-C6 and requires the `auto` or `lltf` capture profile. `external` sends no traffic: another host sets the pace by sending unicast ICMP echo requests to the device, or UDP datagrams to port 5555 whose payload is the four bytes `F0 9F 91 BB`. The detector expects about 100 packets per second. Broadcast traffic does not give reliable CSI; use unicast or multicast.

config_entries.label: Traffic Generator Target IP
config_entries.description: Destination for generated IP traffic. Defaults to the Wi-Fi gateway. Select a unicast address that responds to the chosen traffic mode. DNS modes require a DNS server on port 53, with TCP support for `dns_tcp`. This option cannot be used with `wifi_raw` or `external`.
